# Konsumfunktion

## Verfügbares Einkommen

$$Y_t = w_t N_t + D_t$$

$$Y_{t+1} = w_{t+1} N_{t+1} + D_{t+1}  + (1 + r_t) S_t$$

$$D_{t+1} = Y_{t+1} + (1 - \delta) K_{t+1} - w_{t+1} N_{t+1} - (1 + r_t) B_t^I$$

$$B_t^I = K_{t+1} - (1 - \delta) K_t=I_t$$
$$Y_t=C_t+G_t+I_t$$

## Konsum in $t$

$$C_t(r, W) = \frac{W}{1 + \beta^{\frac{1}{\sigma}} (1+r)^{\frac{1-\sigma}{\sigma}}}$$


$$C_{t+1} = (1 + r_t) \left[ w_t N_t + D_t - C_t \right] + w_{t+1} N_{t+1} + D_{t+1}$$


# Produktion

## Produktionsfunktion

$$\begin{align*}
Y_t &= A_t K_t^{\alpha} N_t^{1-\alpha}, \quad 0 < \alpha < 1 \\
Y_{t+1} &= A_{t+1} K_{t+1}^{\alpha} N_{t+1}^{1-\alpha}
\end{align*}$$


## Arbeitsnachfrage

$$(1 - \alpha) A_t \left(\frac{K_t}{N_t}\right)^{\alpha} = w_t$$

::: {.callout-note icon="false" collapse="true"}
## Umstellen der Arbeitsnachfragefunktion {.unnumbered}

$$
\begin{aligned}
(1 - \alpha) A_t \left(\frac{K_t}{N_t}\right)^{\alpha} &= w_t \\
\left(\frac{K_t}{N_t}\right)^{\alpha} &= \frac{w_t}{(1 - \alpha) A_t} \\
\frac{K_t}{N_t} &= \left(\frac{w_t}{(1 - \alpha) A_t}\right)^{\frac{1}{\alpha}} \\
N^d_t &= K_t \left(\frac{(1 - \alpha) A_t}{w_t}\right)^{\frac{1}{\alpha}}
\end{aligned}
$$
:::


$$N^D_t = K_t \left(\frac{(1 - \alpha) A_t}{w_t}\right)^{\frac{1}{\alpha}}$$

$$N^D_{t+1} = K_{t+1} \left(\frac{(1 - \alpha) A_{t+1}}{w_{t+1}}\right)^{\frac{1}{\alpha}}$$

## Investitionsnachfrage

$$\alpha A_{t+1} \left(\frac{N_{t+1}}{K_{t+1}}\right)^{1 - \alpha} = r_t +\delta$$

mit: $$K_{t+1} = I_t + (1 - \delta) K_t$$

$$ \alpha A_{t+1} \left(\frac{N_{t+1}}{I_t + (1 - \delta) K_t}\right)^{1 - \alpha} = r_t +\delta$$

::: {.callout-note icon="false" collapse="true"}
## Umstellen der Investitionsfunktion {.unnumbered}

$$
\begin{aligned}
\alpha A_{t+1} \left(\frac{N_{t+1}}{I_t + (1 - \delta) K_t}\right)^{1 - \alpha} &= r_t + \delta \\
\left(\frac{N_{t+1}}{I_t + (1 - \delta) K_t}\right)^{1 - \alpha} &= \frac{r_t + \delta}{\alpha A_{t+1}} \\
\frac{N_{t+1}}{I_t + (1 - \delta) K_t} &= \left(\frac{r_t + \delta}{\alpha A_{t+1}}\right)^{\frac{1}{1 - \alpha}} \\
I_t + (1 - \delta) K_t &= N_{t+1} \left(\frac{\alpha A_{t+1}}{r_t + \delta}\right)^{\frac{1}{1 - \alpha}} \\
I_t &= N_{t+1} \left(\frac{\alpha A_{t+1}}{r_t + \delta}\right)^{\frac{1}{1 - \alpha}} - (1 - \delta) K_t
\end{aligned}
$$

:::


$$I_t = N_{t+1} \left(\frac{\alpha A_{t+1}}{r_t + \delta}\right)^{\frac{1}{1 - \alpha}} - (1 - \delta) K_t$$

## Arbeitsangebot

$$\theta_t \frac{1}{1 - N_t} = w_t$$

$$N^S_t = 1 - \frac{\theta_t}{w_t}$$

$$N^S_{t+1} = 1 - \frac{\theta_{t+1}}{w_{t+1}}$$
[Korrekturen oben noch einpflegen]::


# Lösung

```{r}
solve_macro_model <- function(
  K_t = 10, delta = 0.1,
  theta_t = 0.5, theta_t1 = 0.5,
  G_t = 0.5, G_t1 = 0.5,
  sigma = 1.0, beta = 0.96,
  A_t = 10, A_t1 = 10,
  alpha = 0.33
) {
  # --- 1. Periode t: Arbeitsmarkt & Produktion (unabhängig von r_t) ---
  labor_eq_t <- function(w) {
    Nd <- K_t * ((1 - alpha) * A_t / w)^(1 / alpha)
    Ns <- 1 - theta_t / w
    return(Nd - Ns)
  }
  w_t <- uniroot(labor_eq_t, interval = c(theta_t + 1e-6, 100))$root
  N_t <- 1 - theta_t / w_t
  Y_t <- A_t * K_t^alpha * N_t^(1 - alpha)
  D_t <- Y_t - w_t * N_t

  # --- 2. Funktionen in Abhängigkeit vom Realzins r_t ---
  eval_given_r <- function(r) {
    k_n_ratio <- (alpha * A_t1 / (r + delta))^(1 / (1 - alpha))
    w_t1 <- (1 - alpha) * A_t1 * (k_n_ratio)^alpha
    N_t1 <- 1 - theta_t1 / w_t1
    
    if (is.na(N_t1) || N_t1 <= 0) return(list(excess_demand = NA))
    
    K_t1 <- k_n_ratio * N_t1
    I_t  <- K_t1 - (1 - delta) * K_t
    B_I  <- I_t
    Y_t1 <- A_t1 * K_t1^alpha * N_t1^(1 - alpha)
    D_t1 <- Y_t1 + (1 - delta) * K_t1 - w_t1 * N_t1 - (1 + r) * B_I
    
    W <- (w_t * N_t + D_t - G_t) + (w_t1 * N_t1 + D_t1 - G_t1) / (1 + r)
    
    C_t  <- W / (1 + beta^(1 / sigma) * (1 + r)^((1 - sigma) / sigma))
    S_t  <- w_t * N_t + D_t - G_t - C_t
    C_t1 <- (1 + r) * S_t + w_t1 * N_t1 + D_t1 - G_t1
    
    excess_demand <- C_t + I_t + G_t - Y_t
    
    list(
      r_t = r, w_t = w_t, N_t = N_t, Y_t = Y_t, D_t = D_t,
      C_t = C_t, I_t = I_t, S_t = S_t, G_t = G_t,
      w_t1 = w_t1, N_t1 = N_t1, K_t1 = K_t1, Y_t1 = Y_t1,
      D_t1 = D_t1, C_t1 = C_t1, G_t1 = G_t1, W = W,
      excess_demand = excess_demand,
      check_t1 = Y_t1 + (1 - delta) * K_t1 - (C_t1 + G_t1)
    )
  }

  # Analytische Obergrenze r_max für N_{t+1} > 0
  r_max <- alpha * A_t1 * ((1 - alpha) * A_t1 / theta_t1)^((1 - alpha) / alpha) - delta
  r_min <- max(-delta + 1e-5, -0.99)
  
  if (r_max <= r_min) {
    stop("Kein positives Arbeitsangebot in t+1 möglich (theta_{t+1} zu hoch oder A_{t+1} zu niedrig).")
  }

  # Gleichgewichtszins r_t suchen
  r_star <- uniroot(
    function(r) eval_given_r(r)$excess_demand,
    interval = c(r_min, r_max - 1e-6)
  )$root
  
  return(eval_given_r(r_star))
}

# Testlauf
base  <- solve_macro_model(G_t = 0.5, G_t1 = 0.5)
shock <- solve_macro_model(G_t = 0.8, G_t1 = 0.5)

options(scipen = 999)

library(knitr)

vars <- c("r_t", "Y_t", "C_t", "I_t", "N_t", "w_t", "Y_t1", "C_t1", "K_t1", "check_t1")
labels <- c(
  "$r_t$", "$Y_t$", "$C_t$", "$I_t$", "$N_t$",
  "$w_t$", "$Y_{t+1}$", "$C_{t+1}$", "$K_{t+1}$", "$\\text{Check}_{t+1}$"
)

out_df <- data.frame(
  Variable = labels,
  Baseline = unlist(base[vars]),
  G_t_Schock = unlist(shock[vars]),
  row.names = NULL
)

kable(
  out_df,
  digits = 2,
  col.names = c("Variable", "Baseline", "$G_t$-Schock"),
  align = c("l", "r", "r"),
  escape = FALSE,
  caption = "Modellgleichgewicht: Baseline vs. temporärer Staatsausgabenschock ($G_t$)"
)


```

```{r}
#| warning: false
#| message: false

library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

# --- 1. Modellfunktion (mit A = 10 als Standard für positive Investitionen) ---
solve_macro_model <- function(
  K_t = 10, delta = 0.1,
  theta_t = 0.5, theta_t1 = 0.5,
  G_t = 0.5, G_t1 = 0.5,
  sigma = 1.0, beta = 0.96,
  A_t = 10.0, A_t1 = 10.0,
  alpha = 0.33
) {
  labor_eq_t <- function(w) {
    Nd <- K_t * ((1 - alpha) * A_t / w)^(1 / alpha)
    Ns <- 1 - theta_t / w
    return(Nd - Ns)
  }
  w_t <- uniroot(labor_eq_t, interval = c(theta_t + 1e-6, 100))$root
  N_t <- 1 - theta_t / w_t
  Y_t <- A_t * K_t^alpha * N_t^(1 - alpha)
  D_t <- Y_t - w_t * N_t

  eval_given_r <- function(r) {
    k_n_ratio <- (alpha * A_t1 / (r + delta))^(1 / (1 - alpha))
    w_t1 <- (1 - alpha) * A_t1 * (k_n_ratio)^alpha
    N_t1 <- 1 - theta_t1 / w_t1
    if (is.na(N_t1) || N_t1 <= 0) return(list(excess_demand = NA))

    K_t1 <- k_n_ratio * N_t1
    I_t  <- K_t1 - (1 - delta) * K_t
    B_I  <- I_t
    Y_t1 <- A_t1 * K_t1^alpha * N_t1^(1 - alpha)
    D_t1 <- Y_t1 + (1 - delta) * K_t1 - w_t1 * N_t1 - (1 + r) * B_I

    W <- (w_t * N_t + D_t - G_t) + (w_t1 * N_t1 + D_t1 - G_t1) / (1 + r)
    C_t  <- W / (1 + beta^(1 / sigma) * (1 + r)^((1 - sigma) / sigma))
    S_t  <- w_t * N_t + D_t - G_t - C_t
    C_t1 <- (1 + r) * S_t + w_t1 * N_t1 + D_t1 - G_t1

    excess_demand <- C_t + I_t + G_t - Y_t

    list(
      r_t = r, w_t = w_t, N_t = N_t, Y_t = Y_t, D_t = D_t,
      C_t = C_t, I_t = I_t, S_t = S_t, G_t = G_t,
      w_t1 = w_t1, N_t1 = N_t1, K_t1 = K_t1, Y_t1 = Y_t1,
      D_t1 = D_t1, C_t1 = C_t1, G_t1 = G_t1, W = W,
      excess_demand = excess_demand,
      check_t1 = Y_t1 + (1 - delta) * K_t1 - (C_t1 + G_t1)
    )
  }

  r_max <- alpha * A_t1 * ((1 - alpha) * A_t1 / theta_t1)^((1 - alpha) / alpha) - delta
  r_min <- max(-delta + 1e-5, -0.99)
  r_star <- uniroot(
    function(r) eval_given_r(r)$excess_demand,
    interval = c(r_min, r_max - 1e-6)
  )$root

  out <- eval_given_r(r_star)
  out$eval_given_r <- eval_given_r
  out$r_max <- r_max
  return(out)
}

# Parameter & Gleichgewichte berechnen
params <- list(
  K_t = 10, delta = 0.1, theta_t = 0.5, theta_t1 = 0.5,
  G_t0 = 0.5, G_t1_shock = 0.8, G_t1 = 0.5,
  sigma = 1.0, beta = 0.96, A_t = 10.0, A_t1 = 10.0, alpha = 0.33
)

eq0 <- do.call(solve_macro_model, c(
  params[c("K_t", "delta", "theta_t", "theta_t1", "G_t1", "sigma", "beta", "A_t", "A_t1", "alpha")],
  list(G_t = params$G_t0)
))
eq1 <- do.call(solve_macro_model, c(
  params[c("K_t", "delta", "theta_t", "theta_t1", "G_t1", "sigma", "beta", "A_t", "A_t1", "alpha")],
  list(G_t = params$G_t1_shock)
))

theme_macro <- theme_light(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11.5),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_blank()
  )

# --- GRAFIK 1: Arbeitsmarkt in Periode t ---
w_grid <- seq(params$theta_t + 0.05, max(eq0$w_t * 1.4, 8), length.out = 200)
df_labor <- data.frame(
  w  = w_grid,
  Nd = params$K_t * ((1 - params$alpha) * params$A_t / w_grid)^(1 / params$alpha),
  Ns = 1 - params$theta_t / w_grid
)

p_labor <- ggplot(df_labor, aes(x = Nd, y = w)) +
  geom_line(aes(x = Nd, color = "Arbeitsnachfrage (N^d)"), linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_line(aes(x = Ns, color = "Arbeitsangebot (N^s)"), linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = params$theta_t, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
  geom_point(aes(x = eq0$N_t, y = eq0$w_t), color = "black", size = 2.5) +
  annotate("segment", x = eq0$N_t, xend = eq0$N_t, y = 0, yend = eq0$w_t, linetype = "dotted", color = "grey40") +
  annotate("segment", x = 0, xend = eq0$N_t, y = eq0$w_t, yend = eq0$w_t, linetype = "dotted", color = "grey40") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Arbeitsnachfrage (N^d)" = "black", "Arbeitsangebot (N^s)" = "#2E75B6")) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 1.05), ylim = c(0, max(w_grid))) +
  labs(
    title = "Arbeitsmarkt in Periode t",
    x = expression(Arbeitsmenge~N[t]),
    y = expression(Reallohn~w[t])
  ) +
  theme_macro

# --- GRAFIK 2: Produktionsfunktion Y_t(N_t) ---
n_grid <- seq(0.01, 0.99, length.out = 200)
df_prod <- data.frame(
  N = n_grid,
  Y = params$A_t * params$K_t^params$alpha * n_grid^(1 - params$alpha)
)

p_prod <- ggplot(df_prod, aes(x = N, y = Y)) +
  geom_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_point(aes(x = eq0$N_t, y = eq0$Y_t), color = "#2E75B6", size = 2.8) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = eq0$N_t, xend = eq0$N_t, y = 0, yend = eq0$Y_t), linetype = "dotted", color = "grey40") +
  geom_segment(aes(x = 0, xend = eq0$N_t, y = eq0$Y_t, yend = eq0$Y_t), linetype = "dotted", color = "grey40") +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 1), ylim = c(0, max(df_prod$Y) * 1.05)) +
  labs(
    title = "Produktionsfunktion in Abhängigkeit von N",
    x = expression(Arbeit~N[t]),
    y = expression(Output~Y[t])
  ) +
  theme_macro

# --- GRAFIK 3: Gleichgewichtszins über Überschussnachfrage Z(r_t) ---
r_grid <- seq(max(-params$delta + 0.02, -0.05), eq0$r_max * 0.92, length.out = 200)
z0 <- sapply(r_grid, function(r) eq0$eval_given_r(r)$excess_demand)
z1 <- sapply(r_grid, function(r) eq1$eval_given_r(r)$excess_demand)

df_r <- rbind(
  data.frame(r = r_grid, Z = z0, Szenario = "Baseline (G_t = 0.50)"),
  data.frame(r = r_grid, Z = z1, Szenario = "Schock (G_t = 0.80)")
)

p_rate <- ggplot(df_r, aes(x = r, y = Z, color = Szenario)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_point(data = data.frame(
    r = c(eq0$r_t, eq1$r_t),
    Z = c(0, 0),
    Szenario = c("Baseline (G_t = 0.50)", "Schock (G_t = 0.80)")
  ), aes(x = r, y = Z), size = 2.8) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Baseline (G_t = 0.50)" = "black", "Schock (G_t = 0.80)" = "#2E75B6")) +
  labs(
    title = "Gleichgewichtiger Realzins (Z(r_t) = 0)",
    x = expression(Realzins~r[t]),
    y = expression(Überschussnachfrage~Z(r[t]))
  ) +
  theme_macro

# --- GRAFIK 4: Investitionsnachfrage I_t(r_t) ---
inv0 <- sapply(r_grid, function(r) eq0$eval_given_r(r)$I_t)
df_inv <- data.frame(r = r_grid, I = inv0)

p_inv <- ggplot(df_inv, aes(x = r, y = I)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_point(aes(x = eq0$r_t, y = eq0$I_t), color = "#2E75B6", size = 2.8) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = eq0$r_t, xend = eq0$r_t, y = min(0, min(inv0)), yend = eq0$I_t), linetype = "dotted", color = "grey40") +
  geom_segment(aes(x = min(r_grid), xend = eq0$r_t, y = eq0$I_t, yend = eq0$I_t), linetype = "dotted", color = "grey40") +
  labs(
    title = "Investitionen in Abhängigkeit vom Realzins",
    x = expression(Realzins~r[t]),
    y = expression(Investitionen~I[t])
  ) +
  theme_macro

# --- KOMBINATION MIT PATCHWORK ---
(p_labor | p_prod) / (p_rate | p_inv) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "2-Perioden-Makromodell: Zentrale Gleichgewichtsbeziehungen",
    theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13))
  )
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

# --- 1. Modellfunktion ---
solve_macro_model <- function(
  K_t = 10, delta = 0.1,
  theta_t = 0.5, theta_t1 = 0.5,
  G_t = 0.5, G_t1 = 0.5,
  sigma = 1.0, beta = 0.96,
  A_t = 10.0, A_t1 = 10.0,
  alpha = 0.33
) {
  labor_eq_t <- function(w) {
    Nd <- K_t * ((1 - alpha) * A_t / w)^(1 / alpha)
    Ns <- 1 - theta_t / w
    return(Nd - Ns)
  }
  w_t <- uniroot(labor_eq_t, interval = c(theta_t + 1e-6, 100))$root
  N_t <- 1 - theta_t / w_t
  Y_t <- A_t * K_t^alpha * N_t^(1 - alpha)
  D_t <- Y_t - w_t * N_t

  eval_given_r <- function(r) {
    k_n_ratio <- (alpha * A_t1 / (r + delta))^(1 / (1 - alpha))
    w_t1 <- (1 - alpha) * A_t1 * (k_n_ratio)^alpha
    N_t1 <- 1 - theta_t1 / w_t1
    if (is.na(N_t1) || N_t1 <= 0) return(list(excess_demand = NA))

    K_t1 <- k_n_ratio * N_t1
    I_t  <- K_t1 - (1 - delta) * K_t
    B_I  <- I_t
    Y_t1 <- A_t1 * K_t1^alpha * N_t1^(1 - alpha)
    D_t1 <- Y_t1 + (1 - delta) * K_t1 - w_t1 * N_t1 - (1 + r) * B_I

    W <- (w_t * N_t + D_t - G_t) + (w_t1 * N_t1 + D_t1 - G_t1) / (1 + r)
    C_t  <- W / (1 + beta^(1 / sigma) * (1 + r)^((1 - sigma) / sigma))
    S_t  <- w_t * N_t + D_t - G_t - C_t
    C_t1 <- (1 + r) * S_t + w_t1 * N_t1 + D_t1 - G_t1

    excess_demand <- C_t + I_t + G_t - Y_t

    list(
      r_t = r, w_t = w_t, N_t = N_t, Y_t = Y_t, D_t = D_t,
      C_t = C_t, I_t = I_t, S_t = S_t, G_t = G_t,
      w_t1 = w_t1, N_t1 = N_t1, K_t1 = K_t1, Y_t1 = Y_t1,
      D_t1 = D_t1, C_t1 = C_t1, G_t1 = G_t1, W = W,
      excess_demand = excess_demand,
      check_t1 = Y_t1 + (1 - delta) * K_t1 - (C_t1 + G_t1)
    )
  }

  r_max <- alpha * A_t1 * ((1 - alpha) * A_t1 / theta_t1)^((1 - alpha) / alpha) - delta
  r_min <- max(-delta + 1e-5, -0.99)
  r_star <- uniroot(
    function(r) eval_given_r(r)$excess_demand,
    interval = c(r_min, r_max - 1e-6)
  )$root

  out <- eval_given_r(r_star)
  out$eval_given_r <- eval_given_r
  out$r_max <- r_max
  return(out)
}

params <- list(
  K_t = 10, delta = 0.1, theta_t = 0.5, theta_t1 = 0.5,
  G_t0 = 0.5, G_t1_shock = 0.8, G_t1 = 0.5,
  sigma = 1.0, beta = 0.96, A_t = 10.0, A_t1 = 10.0, alpha = 0.33

  params[c("K_t", "delta", "theta_t", "theta_t1", "G_t1", "sigma", "beta", "A_t", "A_t1", "alpha")],

# --- LINKE SPALTE: Arbeitsmarkt (oben) und Produktionsfunktion (unten), gleiche N_t-Achse ---
n_limits <- c(0, 1.0)
n_breaks <- seq(0, 1.0, by = 0.2)

w_grid <- seq(params$theta_t + 0.05, max(eq0$w_t * 1.35, 7), length.out = 250)
df_labor <- data.frame(
  w  = w_grid,
  Nd = params$K_t * ((1 - params$alpha) * params$A_t / w_grid)^(1 / params$alpha),
  Ns = 1 - params$theta_t / w_grid
)

p_labor <- ggplot(df_labor, aes(y = w)) +
  geom_line(aes(x = Nd, color = "Arbeitsnachfrage (N^d)"), linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_line(aes(x = Ns, color = "Arbeitsangebot (N^s)"), linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = params$theta_t, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey45") +
  geom_point(data = data.frame(x = eq0$N_t, y = eq0$w_t), aes(x = x, y = y), color = "black", size = 2.5) +
  annotate("segment", x = eq0$N_t, xend = eq0$N_t, y = 0, yend = eq0$w_t, linetype = "dotted", color = "grey45") +
  annotate("segment", x = 0, xend = eq0$N_t, y = eq0$w_t, yend = eq0$w_t, linetype = "dotted", color = "grey45") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = n_limits, breaks = n_breaks, expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, max(w_grid)), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Arbeitsnachfrage (N^d)" = "black", "Arbeitsangebot (N^s)" = "#2E75B6")) +
  labs(
    title = "Arbeitsmarkt in Periode t",
    x = NULL,
    y = expression(Reallohn~w[t])
  ) +
  theme_macro +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank())

n_grid <- seq(0.005, 0.995, length.out = 250)
df_prod <- data.frame(
  N = n_grid,
  Y = params$A_t * params$K_t^params$alpha * n_grid^(1 - params$alpha)
)

p_prod <- ggplot(df_prod, aes(x = N, y = Y)) +
  geom_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_point(aes(x = eq0$N_t, y = eq0$Y_t), color = "#2E75B6", size = 2.8) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = eq0$N_t, xend = eq0$N_t, y = 0, yend = eq0$Y_t), linetype = "dotted", color = "grey45") +
  geom_segment(aes(x = 0, xend = eq0$N_t, y = eq0$Y_t, yend = eq0$Y_t), linetype = "dotted", color = "grey45") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = n_limits, breaks = n_breaks, expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, max(df_prod$Y) * 1.05), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(
    title = "Produktionsfunktion in Abhängigkeit von N",
    x = expression(Arbeit~N[t]),
    y = expression(Output~Y[t])
  ) +
  theme_macro

# --- RECHTE SPALTE: Gezielte r_t-Skalierung rund um die Gleichgewichte ---
r_center <- mean(c(eq0$r_t, eq1$r_t))
r_span   <- max(0.08, abs(eq1$r_t - eq0$r_t) * 2.2)
r_low    <- max(-params$delta + 0.01, r_center - r_span)
r_high   <- min(eq0$r_max * 0.75, r_center + r_span)
r_grid   <- seq(r_low, r_high, length.out = 250)

z0 <- sapply(r_grid, function(r) eq0$eval_given_r(r)$excess_demand)
z1 <- sapply(r_grid, function(r) eq1$eval_given_r(r)$excess_demand)

df_r <- rbind(
  data.frame(r = r_grid, Z = z0, Szenario = "Baseline (G_t = 0.50)"),
  data.frame(r = r_grid, Z = z1, Szenario = "Schock (G_t = 0.80)")
)

p_rate <- ggplot(df_r, aes(x = r, y = Z, color = Szenario)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey35", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_point(
    data = data.frame(
      r = c(eq0$r_t, eq1$r_t),
      Z = c(0, 0),
      Szenario = c("Baseline (G_t = 0.50)", "Schock (G_t = 0.80)")
    ),
    aes(x = r, y = Z),
    size = 2.8
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(r_low, r_high),
    labels = function(x) sprintf("%.2f", x),
    expand = c(0.02, 0.02)
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Baseline (G_t = 0.50)" = "black", "Schock (G_t = 0.80)" = "#2E75B6")) +
  labs(
    title = "Gleichgewichtiger Realzins (Z(r_t) = 0)",
    x = expression(Realzins~r[t]),
    y = expression(Überschussnachfrage~Z(r[t]))
  ) +
  theme_macro

inv0 <- sapply(r_grid, function(r) eq0$eval_given_r(r)$I_t)
inv1 <- sapply(r_grid, function(r) eq1$eval_given_r(r)$I_t)

df_inv <- rbind(
  data.frame(r = r_grid, I = inv0, Szenario = "Baseline (G_t = 0.50)"),
  data.frame(r = r_grid, I = inv1, Szenario = "Schock (G_t = 0.80)")
)

p_inv <- ggplot(df_inv, aes(x = r, y = I, color = Szenario)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey35", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_point(
    data = data.frame(
      r = c(eq0$r_t, eq1$r_t),
      I = c(eq0$I_t, eq1$I_t),
      Szenario = c("Baseline (G_t = 0.50)", "Schock (G_t = 0.80)")
    ),
    aes(x = r, y = I),
    size = 2.8
  ) +
  geom_segment(
    data = data.frame(r = eq0$r_t, I = eq0$I_t),
    aes(x = r, xend = r, y = min(0, min(c(inv0, inv1))), yend = I),
    linetype = "dotted", color = "grey45", inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(r_low, r_high),
    labels = function(x) sprintf("%.2f", x),
    expand = c(0.02, 0.02)
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Baseline (G_t = 0.50)" = "black", "Schock (G_t = 0.80)" = "#2E75B6")) +
  labs(
    title = "Investitionen in Abhängigkeit vom Realzins",
    x = expression(Realzins~r[t]),
    y = expression(Investitionen~I[t])
  ) +
  theme_macro

# --- KOMBINATION MIT PATCHWORK (Spaltenweise: links N_t-Achse, rechts r_t-Achse) ---
(p_labor / p_prod + plot_layout(heights = c(1, 1))) |
  (p_rate / p_inv + plot_layout(heights = c(1, 1))) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "2-Perioden-Makromodell: Arbeitsmarkt, Produktion, Zins und Investitionen",
    theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12.5))
  )

```
